title: Quota probe
description: Reads the account's rate limits from Claude while no session's turn does.

every.description: How often it reads while no session's turn does, such as "10m" ("s", "m" or "h"): a minute at least.

reads.description: Each read of the account's rate limits, answered or not.

u.description: An answered read: Claude's get_usage answer as it came, nulls dropped, and the reading made of it (a reading with no runtime is Claude's).

unavailable.description: The answer says the account has no rate limits to read.

f.description: A read with no answer, and why.

p.description: A read as the core's quota probe wrote it before tower 1.88, answered or not: kept, and never written again.

every.description: How often it reads while nothing else holds it, ms.

lastAt.description: When it last read, answered or not.

error.description: Why its last read has no answer.

wait.description: How long it waits after its last read, ms: every, longer while backing off or unavailable.

nextAt.description: When it reads next: a moment past means at the next tick.

held.description: nextAt is set by a session's turn, which read every limit it reads.

read-now.description: Read the account's rate limits now, whatever the stream says, appended to it as any read is. Refused while a read is in flight, or within a minute of the last read's start.

at.description: When the read started, epoch ms.

error.description: Why the read has no answer.

words.label: Read now
words.hint: Read the account's rate limits now (at most once a minute)

reads.description: The latest reads, newest first, each Claude's answer as it came or why there is none.

status.description: Whether it reads the rate limits: its line when it does; refused, saying why and what to do, when its last read failed, the account has none to read, or it is overdue.

words.label: The quota probe reads the rate limits
